tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba'i tshul la/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mkhas rmongs mang po'i chos skyong gzhan gyis rjes gnang gi rgyas bkab pa dang / rang bzo rnam pa gar 'char la mchor chas byas pa sogs bsre slad du gyur pa 'ga' zhig snang mod na'ang / de dag btang snyoms su bzhag nas brgyud pa 'di pa'i lugs kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i yi ge ni/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gtor dbang bar chad kun sel du grags pa'i yi ge 'di nyid gtso bor byas pa la brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal shes dang / lag len gyis brgyan nas gsal bar ston pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po sbyor ba ni dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma dang mgon po 'khor bcas kyi bris sku la sogs pa'i drung du/ cog tse la sogs pa'i steng du khar rdul tshon gyis bris pa'am/ dar ram ras la sogs pa la chu tshon gyis bris pa gang yang rung ba'i maṇ+ḍal/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag re kha rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ mtha' mar me ris rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba/ zur gcig rang ngos la bstan pa/ de'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag gi lte ba la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa'am/ yang na hūm̐ yig rkyang pa bris pa'am/ tshom bu bkod kyang rung / dbus su mañji'i khar gtor ma dpal bshos zur gsum pa mtha' mtheb kyus bskor ba de la mda' rgod sgro ma dar nag gi cod paṇa can btsugs/ mgon po'i tsakli yod na yang gtor ma la byugs pa phyag len yin/ chos 'byung gi g.yas su yi dam gyi gtor ma dang / g.yon du gzhi bdag gtor ma gnyis zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba/ mdun du mgon po 'di nyid kyi 'bul gtor gru gsum mtheb kyus bskor ba/

gzhan yang chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga dang bcas pa/ sgrub ba po rang nyid kyi mdun du nang mchod/ rdor dril/ me tog phor 'brus bkang ba la sogs pa ma tshang pa med pa bshams/ de nas slob dpon gyis kye rdor ram bde mchog gam spyan ras gzigs rta mgrin gsang sgrub la sogs pa 'di 'brel chags shing skabs su bab pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song ba'i mthar mdun gyi chos 'byung gtor ma dang bcas pa la dmigs te/ a mri tas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal gyi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me ris 'bar ba'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las gri gug gi lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes pa spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug gnyis pa na thod 'phreng / gsum pa na ḍā ma ru dkrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod khrag gnyis pa na rtse gsum/ gsum pa na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan zhing glang po che'i lpags pas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pas sham thabs la dar ljang khu'i ska rags bcings pa/ dpral bar sin+d+du ra'i thig le byugs shing / spyi bor mi bskyod pa'i brgyan pa phyag zhabs thams cad la rus pa'i 'phreng ba dang / dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs kyis ye shes me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dmar la dwangs pa'i nang du bh+yo las 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu la bzhon pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/

g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na gri gug g.yon gyi dang po na rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa na thod rlon khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa snyan g.yas pa la seng ge dang / g.yon pa la dug sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dmar ser 'bar ba dbu la zla tshes dang / rma bya'i mdongs kyis spras pa/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma 'char ba/ zhing chen dang glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / re lde'i sham thabs la sbrul nag gi ska rags bcings pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ ma mo dang sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na bh+yo'i sgra sgrog pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du k+ṣiṃ las gnod sbyin k+ṣi ṭa pa dom nag smyon pa la chibs pa/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba gtso bo'i zhal du stob pa/ ral pa gyen du gzing zhing spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ mgon po'i g.yas su 'dziṃ las dbang phyug dzi na mi tra sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mgon po'i rgyab tu traṃ las gshin rje trag ki ra dza sku mdog smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'phyar zhing / g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba lha mo'i g.yon du hūm̐ las bdud mgon trag shad nag po g.yas ru tshon dmar po 'phyar zhing / g.yon tsan dan gyi beng shing snom pa/ za 'og sngo phra'i ber gsol zhing rta nag rting dkar la chibs pa/ bzhi ka'ang rngam zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dbu skra khams ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyan gsum dmar la g.yo ba dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan gyis mdzes shing / ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi phyi rol du phyogs skyong bcu/

lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu ste gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang / bka' bstod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod tsan dan sdong po rkang gcig pa'i drung nas/ dpal nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzā/ dril bu gsil zhing / hūm̐ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /tshur gshegs mahā ka la'i tshogs/ /ji ltar khas blang dam bcas bzhin/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /k+ṣe tra pā la la sogs pa'i/ /'khor gyi gnod sbyin bka' nyan tshogs/ /bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la yā+e mahā kā li de wi yak+ṣa sa pā ri wa re i h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho zhes brjod pas mdun bskyed la bstim/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la sa pā ri wa re sngon du 'gro ba'i mthar ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye sa pā ri wa re oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ mahā kā la phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku/ /sku'i cha lugs mi zad 'bar ba las/ /dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa sogs/ /gsung gi nga ro mi zad 'bar ba las/ /hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra yis stong gsum khengs/ /rnam dag thugs ni mi zad 'bar ba las/ /spros dang bral yang mtshan ma cir yang ston/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sgo nas khyed la bstod/ /ces pas bstod la/ de nas yi dam gyi gtor ma la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ yi dam gyi lha gang yin pa'i mtshan sngags gyi mthar i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis 'bul/

mtshan sngags kyi mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ lha rang rang gi bstod pas bstod/ mdun gyi chos skyong gi gtor ma la dmigs te/ a mri tas bsangs/ swa bha bas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pa la big+nan bi nā ya ka i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā lan gsum gyis gtso bo la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra big+nan bi nā ya ka raka mo bha ling+ta maṃ sa rak+ta tu ṭa kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis lha mo la 'bul/ de nas chos skyong spyi'i sngags sha sa na lan gsum gyis gtso 'khor thams cad la dmigs nas thun mong du phul la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti 'khor gnod sbyin bzhi gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad zhi ba dang / bsam pa chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod/ de nas gtso bo la dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pa la big+nan bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bgrang / lha mo la dmigs nas oṃ badz+ra na ra k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa grangs ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ 'khor gnod sbyin bzhi la dmigs nas rim bzhin/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pa la big+nan hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ dzi na mi tra wa shaṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traka ki rā dza sa ma ya bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dud yag dza mahā kā la trag sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nyer gcig re bzla/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni slob ma bos la khrus byas phyag dang yon phul te gral la 'khod pa la/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dam pa'i chos nyams su len snyam pa'i bsam pa drag po re bskyed par mdzod/ de ltar dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa la bar chad sel bar byed pa'i srung ma khyad par can re bsten dgos pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su bab pa thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gdul bya'i don du/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i srung ma'i dam por sku sprul pa myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'di yin la/ 'di ni mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rgya gar du mnga' bdag mai tri pa la gser srang bdun phul nas nged bod rnams longs spyod chung ba yin pas nor sgrub/ mthu myur la rtags mtshan che ba gcig zhu byas pas/ mai tri pa'i zhal nas yid bzhin gyi mgon po zhes kyang bya/ mgon po shing phung can zhes kyang bya/ thugs rje chen po zhes kyang bya/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes kyang bya/ 'dis bar do'i 'jigs pa las skyob/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ mi nor bzas gsum shugs la 'byung / dgra thams cad brlag par byed/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad lo zlas 'grub pa zhig yod de sbyin gsungs/ de bla mas su la gsan zhus pas mai tri pa'i zhal nas kho bos sha wa ri dbang phyug las thos/ sha wa ri de dur khrod chen po bsil ba tshal na sgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru dang dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra chen po grags nas gzigs pa dang / ye shes kyi mgon po 'di byon nas rigs kyi bu sgrub thabs zungs shig gsungs nas/

sha wa ri pas sgrub thabs yi ger bkod par yang mdzad gsungs/ yang sngon gyi dus na dur khrod chen po mun pa mi zad pa zhes bya bar slob dpon dha na saṃskri ta zhes bya bas/ ye shes kyi mgon po 'dis zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ 'khor gnod sbyin rnams kyi srog sngags phul nas las thams cad sgrub par khas blangs pa'i bla ma des/ ra hu la gup+ta badz+ra la gnang / ra hu las gdams ngag sgo skyel mdzad du byon nas/ khyung po la gnang / khyung po nas bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byung ba yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/ de lta bu'i ye shes kyi mgon po'i rjes su gnang ba la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin/ dngos gzhi slob ma dang thun mong gi bya ba'i rim pa la sngon 'gro skyabs sems bya ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin chen rnam pa gsum mkha' 'gro chos srung dang bcas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro snyam pas/ 'dis rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun dang bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha dang ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug sems bskyed pa ni/ gong gi skyabs yul de rnams kyi spyan sngar yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum ma bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug rjes gnang dngos la mdun du rten gsal btab cing ye shes pa spyan drangs pa/

dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba/ sngags kyi bzlas lung byin pa dang bzhi yod pa'i/ dang po ni/ mdun phyogs kyi chos 'byung gtor ma dang bcas pa'i gnas 'di nyid du ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa tsan dan gyi ljon shing nags tshal khrag gi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum gyi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma tshogs kyi bdag po gan sgyal du 'gyel ba'i steng du myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes pa nas/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis skor ba bcas pa'i bar mdun bskyed kyi mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin brjod la 'di rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon la kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /zhes pa nas blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod du gzhug yang slob dpon yi dam du gsal gdab pa dang mdun bskyed kyi chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi sku lus la phog pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes pa nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs zhes pa'i bar spyi dang 'dra/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal zhes pa nas/ chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma nyi ma tshogs bdag gan sgyal 'gyel ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing nag de yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa zhes pa nas/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis skor ba bcas pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar bskyed/ de thams cad kyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon la gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas 'od dang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod kyi dbus shing tsan dan gyi sdong po rkang gcig pa'i drung na mgon po 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i thugs khar phog

thugs rje dang thugs dam gyis brgyud bskul sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran pas ye shes kyi mgon po de nyid thogs med du bzhengs nas byon pa la g.yas na dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ g.yon na dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ ma gcig dpal ldan lha mo bka' nyan gyi gnod sbyin chen po bzhi/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad gang ba/ khro zhing 'khrug la dges shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa 'ur 'ur thib thib byon nas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ dril bu gsil dang rol chen bya zhing / mdun bskyed kyi skabs su brjod pa'i spyan 'dren tshigs bcad dang sngags bcas pa'i rjes su k+ṣiṃ nyer gcig dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho zhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas mdun bskyed kyi mgon po de nyid ye shes pa dang dbyer med pa'i myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang nges shes bskyed mdzod/ gnyis pa/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba ni/ khyed rang mgon por gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed kyi mgon po gnyis char gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par a dmar po/ /thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po re gsal btab la slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs lus la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ tshar gcig slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i dpral ba'i oṃ la phog pas mgon po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ oṃ de las mgon po'i sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ la thim ste 'od zer dkar po byung bas lus kyi nang thams cad gang /

tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag mgon po'i sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil zhing / na mo bud+dha ya/ na mo gu ru h+ya badz+ra wi ra wi ri ṇa shrī yi/ badz+ra ḍak+kā ḍak+kī ni/ dzo ka dzo ki ni/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tsha ma kyai/ phyogs bcu na dus gsum bzhugs pa'i drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyi ye shes la sgrib pa mi mnga'/ mthu stobs la thogs pa mi mnga'/ thugs rje la phyi bshol mi mnga'/ byin rlabs la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba khyed rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa'i sgo nas rdo rje'i slob ma 'di'am 'di rnams la zhes pa skabs dang sbyar la dus da lta nyid du byin gyis rlobs shig ces dang oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la k+ṣiṃ k+ṣe tra pā la big+nan bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥswā hā/ mang du brjod/ yang gsang dbang gi slad du gsol btab 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la gsang ba'i dbang bskur du gsol/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag par mdzad du gsol/ gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la 'jug par mdzad du gsol/ tshar gcig slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i mgrin pa'i a la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ aḥde las mgon po'i gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa sogs nas sngags brjod pa'i bar rigs 'gre/ yang gsol btab 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur du gsol/

yid kyi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la 'jug par mdzad du gsol tshar gcig yang slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ la phog pa nas 'od zer sngon po'i 'phro sdud sogs dang / sngags brjod pa'i bar rigs 'gre/ yang 'di gsung bar zhu/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi pa bskur du gsol/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ yon tan 'phrin las kyi byin rlabs 'jug par mdzad du gsol tshar gcig slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la phog pas yig 'bru gsum las de 'dra ba re byung nas khyed rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim/ yang khyed rang gi dpral ba'i oṃ mgrin pa'i ā la thim/ mgrin pa'i ā thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas/ mgon po'i sku dang dbyer med du 'dres/ de yang brtan g.yo 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas/ de thams cad 'od zer sngon po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ de nyid mtha' nas rim bzhin bsdus te dbus nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar sngo yal song bas/ gsal stong zung 'jug brjod bral bde ba chen po'i ngang du lus sems khong glod de ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'jog par zhu/ slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil zhing / na mo bud+dha ya zhes pa nas sngags brjod pa'i bar snga ma gsum dang 'dra/ gsum pa gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ mdun gyi gtor ma de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas khyed rang gi spyi bor 'ur 'ur chem chem bzhugs pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / mtha' 'khor kun tu gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku las 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'phros/

khyed rang gi lus la thim pas sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag mgon po'i sku las mgon po'i sku chung la yan lag rags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa lus kyi cha shas thams cad nas thogs med du zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang sku dges pas gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyis sgra sgrog cing / nad gdon thams cad zhal du dmar 'dzir ri ri gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar gsal ba'i bla ma dang mgon po rnam pa tha dad kyang ngo bo dbyer med pa la mos gus kyi shugs drag po bskyed la rgyas par na brgyud 'debs gnas sbyar ma dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ yang na sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs/ chos sku ye shes mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs/ dpal ldan sha wa ri dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs/ mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs/ myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang gis byin gyis rlobs/ de bzhin du mai tri pa nas bzung bla ma brgyud pa gsum re'i mthar bla ma mgon po dbyer med bcas sbyar/ mdor bsdu na/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med/ mgon po bla ma dbyer med la gsol ba 'debs so/ /ma mtshan ldan gyi bla ma/ pha mtshan ldan gyi chos rje/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can la thugs rjes gzigs/ las ngan 'khor ba nas 'khyam pa la thugs rjes gzigs/ zhes gsol ba btab/ bka' bsgo ba dngos ni/ dpal ldan mahā ka la myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo/ gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pa la/ dbang phyug dzi na mi tra/ gshin rje tra ki rā dza/ bdud mgon trag shad nag po/ ma gcig dus mtshan mkha' 'gro/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar/

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du rdo rje'i slob ma 'di nyid kyi byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs la 'gal rkyen nad gdon bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad pa dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor lung rtogs kyi yon tan la sogs pa legs tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol zhes dang / gong gi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sngags kyi mthar dza hūm̐ baṃ ho zhes brjod/ gong gi bla ma brgyud pa rnams rim bzhin 'od du zhu nas mgon po 'khor bcas la thim/ 'khor rnams kyang gtso bo mgon po nyid la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum dang dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam la brjod bral phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du cung zad re 'jog par zhu/ de'i ngang las ma g.yos par slar yang rang nyid snang stong dbyer med kyi mgon po'i skur gsal lam gyis gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bzhi pa sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ mgon po bdag la bstsal lags kyi/ /bdag la bsgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum byed du gzhug mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi thugs kha'i sngags 'phreng rnams las sngags kyi 'phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam par byon/ so so'i zhal nas thon khyed rang mgon por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig mthing nag gcig bsam pa'i mtha' mar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sogs mgon po'i srog sngags dang / sha sa na dang lha mo dang gnod sbyin bzhi'i sngags rnams rim bzhin lan gsum re slob dpon gyi 'phreng ba la 'jus te rjes zlos byed du gzhug

des sngags thams cad kyi bzlas lung thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas slob dpon gyis 'phreng ba'am me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ngag tu/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang / nus pa sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /khyed rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas bla ma dang mgon po dbyer med du ltos la gsol ba thobs/ nas nag rjen btags kyi gtor ma dang spos sbyar rgyun ma chad par phul/ bya nag khyi nag sogs la rdo mi brgyab pa sogs bslab bya rnams la bslab par bya/ de ltar byas pas chos sgrub pa'i mchog gi yo byad rnyed sla zhing / mgon po 'di ngo bo spyan ras gzigs yin pas thugs rje gzhan las myur ba dang sgrub thag nye ba yin/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang / gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal deng ni sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gsum pa rjes ni thun gtor 'bul mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sogs dang / rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bkra shis rgyas par brjod par bya/ 'di brgyud pa ni rdo rje 'chang / ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dpal sha wa ri dbang phyug mnga' bdag mai tri pa/ grub thob rā hu la gup+ta/ mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor/ mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus/ dben ston skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub shangs ston chen po/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang / drin can sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse dbang phyug rje bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan/ yang tshar chen nas/ rje gong dkar ba/ mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/

spyan mnga' chos rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ 'jam dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngag dbang bstan pa rab rgyas/ des bdag la thugs dges bzhin du gnang ba lags so/ /de ltar myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang bar chad kun sel 'di ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos rgyas par mdzad pa la gzhi brten zhing / de ka bzhin 'dzol med gzhung bsrang la 'on kyang las dang po pa la phan par bya ba'i phyir tshig gi tshegs bskungs te go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi chos grwar chu pho sprel lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// //'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //maṅgalaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 ngag dbang chos grags/ phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
